main_text.p: De Monachis ita Iacobus Kellerus Iesuita in cavea Turturis cap. 17. Haeretici maximè in opinione confirmantur, quod intra suarum regionum fines nihil generosum & excellens (in Monasteriis) sed meri pepones, allia & nasturtia nascantur. Cap. 14. In Monasteriis multitudo fuit malorum, raritas bonorum. Pharisaei domum orationis verterunt in speluncam latronum. Vetus ibi regula laudatur, novis moribus vivitur. Pronae in casum animae pendent. Sunt ibi ulcera, vulnera, putredines.

Ex Astro inexstincto: Dicunt Iesuitae, quod Ordines, id est Monachi, exceptis Iesuitis omnes, vineam sibi commissam ipsi exterminaverint, quòd domos orationis in latronum speluncas converterint, quòd multò maius quàm ullum genus hominum Ecclesiæ damnū intulerint, quòd hodie quoque in Monasteriis Germaniæ sint ulcera, vulnera, putredines, homines otiosi, ignavi, in-utilia

page.notes: Marginal reference "Cap. 14." is printed within the text. The foot line "Ex astro inextincto" is a title-like heading in italic and was not clearly legible; the transcription of the Greek-looking word "Astro" (possibly ἄστρο / "Astro") is doubtful. The catchword "utilia" and signature "E 5" are at the foot.
